description: Tool to create a new Salesforce SObject record. Use when you need to create any type of standard or custom Salesforce object record by specifying the object type and field values.

fields.description: Dictionary of field API names and their values to set on the new record. Keys must be valid field API names for the specified object type. Required fields for the object must be included. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.
fields.title: Fields

sobject_type.description: The API name of the Salesforce object type to create (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Opportunity', 'Lead', 'Case', 'Task'). This is case-sensitive and must match the exact API name in Salesforce.
sobject_type.title: Sobject Type

name: create_s_object_record

CreateSObjectRecordResponse.description: Response from Salesforce SObject creation API.

errors.description: Array of error objects. Empty array when success is true. Contains error details when success is false, including error codes, messages, and affected fields.
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The unique Salesforce ID (15 or 18 characters) assigned to the newly created record. Only present when success is true.
id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the create operation was successful. Returns true if the record was created successfully, false otherwise.
success.title: Success

CreateSObjectRecordResponse.title: CreateSObjectRecordResponse

DuplicateResult.description: Represents the duplicate detection result from Salesforce.

allowSave.description: Whether the record can be saved despite duplicates. When true, the caller can choose to proceed with the save operation by using the Sforce-Duplicate-Rule-Header.
allowSave.title: Allow Save

duplicateRule.description: The name of the duplicate rule that was triggered (e.g., 'Standard_Account_Duplicate_Rule').
duplicateRule.title: Duplicate Rule

duplicateRuleEntityType.description: The entity type of the duplicate rule (e.g., 'Account', 'Contact', 'Lead').
duplicateRuleEntityType.title: Duplicate Rule Entity Type

errorMessage.description: The error message from the duplicate rule (e.g., 'You are creating a duplicate record.').
errorMessage.title: Error Message

matchResults.description: List of match results. Each contains matchRecords with the actual matched record data including Ids. Access matched IDs via: matchResults[i].matchRecords[j].record['Id'].
matchResults.title: Match Results

DuplicateResult.title: DuplicateResult

MatchRecord.description: Represents a matched duplicate record detected by a matching rule.

record.description: The matched record data. Contains 'Id' for the record ID, 'attributes' with 'type' and 'url', and other fields from the CompactLayout.
record.title: Record

MatchRecord.title: MatchRecord

MatchResult.description: Represents a match result from Salesforce duplicate detection.

entityType.description: The type of the matched entity (e.g., 'Contact', 'Lead', 'Account').
entityType.title: Entity Type

errors.description: Any errors related to this match.
errors.title: Errors

matchRecords.description: List of matched duplicate records. Each record contains the actual matched record data including its Id.
matchRecords.title: Match Records

rule.description: The name of the matching rule that found duplicates (e.g., 'Standard_Account_Match_Rule_v1_0').
rule.title: Rule

success.description: Whether the match operation was successful.
success.title: Success

MatchResult.title: MatchResult

SalesforceError.description: Represents a Salesforce API error object.

duplicateResult.description: Details about duplicate detection when errorCode is DUPLICATES_DETECTED. Contains information about matched records and whether save is allowed.
duplicateResult.title: Duplicate Result

errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code identifier (e.g., REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, MALFORMED_ID, INVALID_SESSION_ID, DUPLICATES_DETECTED).
errorCode.title: Error Code

fields.description: Array of field names where the error occurred. Present for field-level validation errors.
fields.title: Fields

message.description: Human-readable description of the error that occurred.
message.title: Message

SalesforceError.title: SalesforceError
